title: vitis flexuosa var. wallichii
intro: Vitis flexuosa var. wallichii, commonly known as Himalayan grape, is a plant species native to the Himalayan region. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Himalayan grape are attributed to its ability to improve cardiovascular health, reduce stress and anxiety, and exhibit antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of Vitis flexuosa var. wallichii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
